messages:
maya: quick sync: after today's canary we need to decide which issues actually block the next milestone vs what we schedule as follow-ons. short thread.
rachel: saw ~0.4% error bump on embeddings for long prompts around 22:30 UTC. raised a ticket.
tony: CS pinged about deterministic caching for two pilot customers; they called it a rollout blocker unless we give guarantees or a documented workaround.
jess: design note: onboarding microcopy and a small layout tweak are easy follow-ons, not blockers.
miles: propose severity rules: severity=blocker if customer-facing SLA breach OR reproducible failure on >1% of requests in a customer sample window. else severity=high/medium/low.
maya: okay but let's be concrete: blocker if 95p latency degrades by >200ms or error rate increases >=0.5% over baseline for 24h in canary. otherwise schedule.
rachel: can we accept a temporary workaround for caching ask (turn off cache for accounts) as mitigation? customers prefer determinism.
tony: they said disabling cache reduces throughput but beats delaying their go-live. they asked for a togglable per-account setting.
jess: UX: per-account toggle will need an extra settings screen, but a quick admin-only toggle is fine for now.
miles: triage labels I'll add: "severity:blocker", "severity:high", "action:mitigate", "action:schedule", "component:embeddings", "component:caching"
infra-bot: alert: embedding-node-7 saw 95p latency spike at 2026-04-12T22:31Z; trace id f2c9a3.
maya: decision: treat embedding perf regression as potential blocker. rachel + miles to own fast triage and try fallback. jess to scope admin toggle UX for admin-only control. tony to draft communication template.
rachel: I'll attach perf flame graphs and a repro script in the ticket. hoping it's a KV-cache coldpath.
miles: fallback plan: (1) toggle per-customer cache off, (2) route to smaller batch mode, (3) if unresolved, failover to older model variant. Rollback last resort.
jess: will mock the admin toggle in the prototype lane today; if approved we can ship as admin-only in <48h.
maya: milestone blocking criteria captured. next: decide staffing for rapid response this week.
tony: I'm available as primary on-call for the feature, miles backup, rachel for deep perf debugging. jess will do customer-facing notes.
maya: timeline: rachel to triage + initial mitigation in 2h, miles to add fallback knobs, jess to draft customer message by EOD, tony to confirm CS escalation plan. reconvene Fri 09:00 PT.
rachel: runbook snippet I'll add to the ticket: steps to flip cache per-account + smoke commands + how to check 95p.
infra-bot: deploy: canary roll v3-onboard (build 2026.4.12-rc4) started.
miles: small aside: let's separate BAU bugs (deferred) vs product enhancements in the board with labels: "scope:hotpath" vs "scope:backlog". keeps prioritization clear.
jess: agreed, and include acceptance criteria: no P0 regressions for 48h in canary for a feature to be promoted.
maya: summary checklist for thread: owners = rachel (triage), miles (fallback/infra), jess (UX & comms), tony (CS escalation); blocker rules = 95p +200ms or error >=0.5% over 24h; mitigations = per-account cache toggle, smaller batches, model-variant failover; timeline = triage in 2h, EOD comms, reconvene Fri 09:00 PT.
tony: adding note: legal review maybe needed if we change SLA commitments for pilot customers. I'll coordinate.
maya: thanks all. I'll create the rotation card and push the labels to the board now. :white_check_mark:
_meta: generated for dataset: post-launch iteration planning - bugs vs enhancements
